about:
# MapUtils

MapUtils extends the World of Warcraft world map, zone map, and minimap with dungeon and raid maps, travel and flight point icons, zone information, and map window options.

## Features

- Adds dungeon and raid maps to the world map, including a level selector for multi-level instances.
- Shows dungeon and raid entrances on the world map and minimap; clicking an entrance on the world map opens its dungeon map.
- Shows piers, zeppelins, and the tram on the world map and minimap, with a tooltip that names the destination.
- Shows flight points on the world map and minimap.
- Shows the level range of a zone when hovering it on the world map.
- Shows the minimum fishing skill of a zone on the world map.
- Shows unexplored areas on the world map and zone map, with a selectable tint (blue, gray, darkened, faded, gold, green, red, purple, or original colors).
- Lets you move the world map by dragging its border and scale it with the grip in the bottom-right corner (50% - 200%). When MoveAny is loaded, MoveAny moves and scales the world map instead.
- Lets you scale the zone map (Shift+M) with the grip in the bottom-right corner (50% - 300%) while it is unlocked.
- Fades the world map and zone map while you move, with an adjustable visibility; the map becomes fully visible again on mouseover.
- Clicking a pier or flight point icon sets it as your waypoint; the waypoint pin stays visible while a navigation target exists.

## Supported clients

- Classic Era
- WoW Forever
- The Burning Crusade Classic

## Installation

1. Copy the `MapUtils` folder into your World of Warcraft `Interface/AddOns` directory.
2. Enable **MapUtils** in the character-selection add-on list.
3. Log in or reload the user interface.

## Configuration

Enter `/maputils` in chat or left-click the minimap button to open the settings window. Right-click the minimap button to hide it; it can be shown again in the **General** category.

The settings are grouped into collapsible categories:

- **General:** minimap button.
- **World map:** map window (move, scale), fade while moving, dungeon and raid maps, map labels (zone levels, fishing skill), and unexplored areas.
- **Zone map (Shift+M):** map window (scale) and fade while moving.
- **Map icons:** piers, zeppelins and tram, dungeon and raid entrances, and flight points, each separately for the world map and the minimap.

A search box at the top filters the settings. New settings are marked with a **[NEW]** badge for 14 days.

`/maputils map` shows or hides the dungeon map of the instance you are in.

Settings are saved account-wide.

## Localization

MapUtils includes translations for all World of Warcraft client locales:

`deDE`, `enUS`, `esES`, `esMX`, `frFR`, `itIT`, `koKR`, `ptBR`, `ruRU`, `zhCN`, and `zhTW`.

## Credits

- Combat pin handling (`CombatPins` in `mapframe.lua`) adapted from [OpenMap](https://github.com/openmap-world/openmap) (MIT, © 2026 OpenMap contributors). See `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`.
- Quest giver and quest turn-in data derived from [QuestieDB](https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB) and [Questie](https://github.com/Questie/Questie) (GPLv3). See `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`.
- WoW Forever dungeon maps (City of Dalaran, Excavation Site: Wetlands, Ruins of Lordaeron, Hall of the Thanes, The Drowned City, Krol'dok Stronghold, Alcaz Prison, Shaper's Terrace) by [Santiago Reyes - Atlas de Azeroth: Forever](https://asguevara433.wixsite.com/srmaps/post/proyecto-atlas-de-azeroth-forever), used with the author's general permission for addons. Watermarks and credits are kept in the art.

# MapUtils by D4KiR

## [v1.8.0](https://github.com/d4kir92/MapUtils/tree/v1.8.0) (2026-11-26)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/MapUtils/compare/v1.7.39...v1.8.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/MapUtils/releases)

- v1.8.0  
- Add CPU-optimized 3D player position tracking inside dungeons and raids  
    - Optimize CPU and memory usage with stationary sleep mode, throttled updates, and zero per-tick allocations  
    - Show the player arrow on both the stitched minimap view and Classic painted dungeon maps  
- ref  
- Add multi-floor minimap view and switchable floor selector mode  
    - Add stitched client minimap tile view for 13 WMO dungeons/raids and 3 outdoor ADT dungeons/raids  
    - Highlight the selected dungeon floor while dimming other floors and auto-centering on floor switches  
    - Place the Map/Minimap toggle button in GameMenu button style next to the Boss pins slider and hide it when no minimap data exists  
    - Add a map button with tooltip in the Floors widget header to move floor selection back to the world map navigation bar  
    - Add a divider and switch-back entry in the navigation bar floor dropdown with a confirmation dialog for every mode switch  
    - Fix Lua error when dragging or collapsing the instance level panel  
    - Add localized labels and confirmation prompts across all 11 locales  
- Revert "Add Comprehension orders for untranslated scrolls"  
- Add Comprehension orders for untranslated scrolls  
    - Crafting orders can be placed for Comprehension, with the untranslated scrolls from your bags filled in

# MapUtils by D4KiR

## [v1.7.39](https://github.com/d4kir92/MapUtils/tree/v1.7.39) (2026-11-26)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/MapUtils/compare/v1.7.38...v1.7.39) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/MapUtils/releases)

- v1.7.39  
- Add viewport-weighted zone hysteresis to One Map  
    - One Map now picks the zone covering most of the visible land area instead of only the center pixel  
    - Keep the current zone active until another zone leads by at least 25% of the visible land area so pins from other map addons do not jump on small drags across borders  
- Restore world map addon compatibility and defer pin passthrough in combat on WoW Forever  
    - Use standard One Map smooth zoom on WoW Forever so third-party map addons (Spoken Places, Azeroth Fieldbook, RareScanner) and Blizzard quest areas work properly  
    - Re-enable combat pin passthrough deferral outside gamepad mode to prevent SetPassThroughButtons blocked-action errors when opening the world map in combat  
- Prevent terrain tile flicker on zone switches  
    - Keep terrain map alpha stable during One Map zone switches  
    - Preload a 1-tile ring around the viewport and hold off releasing terrain tiles during zone switches  
- Rescale third-party map pins during smooth zoom  
    - Third-party addon pins outside Blizzard's pin pools (such as RareScanner) now scale properly when zooming in with One Map on Forever
